scope: Four naturally selected continuous save branches, twelve trips each. Data completeness is separate from experience approval.
hardChecks: 48 unique settled runs; fixed low/medium/severe and low-medium-severe alternating policies; 16 trips per grade
Replay each requested seed with its actual departure-before history through the frozen selector and match the committed world
Exact save-byte chain, cycle increment, one bounded history append, no extra append on return/preparation; no grants, selected world or rerolls
Actual non-entry collected nodes are backed by terminal field evidence; no more than three successful searches per trip
Q/F/G logs match the real slot, equipped item and positive remaining charges; passive slots are never pressed; surviving active-tool charges reconcile
Repair/growth payments reconcile with saved reserves; returns settle once; runtime and navigation errors stay explicit
metrics: Within-branch immediate same-world and neighbor events over 44 transitions, last-eight recurrence, distinct worlds, longest material/shape streaks
Per-step same-world and neighbor probabilities from the actual pre-departure weights; compare descriptively, never demand zero repeats
Requested/effective seeds and matching bounded generation attempt indices; rejection reasons remain unobserved unless separately recorded
Key attempts, successful consumption and no-consumption attempts by Q/F/G and item; list uncovered active keys
Search/extract, empty extract, death, field duration, successful search count per field minute, return condition
Initial/returned/prepared kindling, actual repair/growth expenditure, reserve delta, returned and destroyed items, module/growth changes
mandatoryDiagnosisFlags: Three consecutive empty returns or deaths within one branch
A twelve-trip branch has no actual non-entry search followed by extraction
Repeated inability to prepare or depart; never replace the missing trip with a new seed
Any source, transaction, tool-consumption, selection replay or navigation contract failure

review.visual: Review actual normal frames and concrete repeated/weak-world cases; metrics do not approve visual fatigue or transitions.
review.audio: Actual subjective listening remains unverified by this automated run.
review.economy: Finite mature-save trajectories, not I13 final economy or success-rate estimates. Severe net loss is recorded, not automatically called a program bug.
review.sampling: 48 trips are not all-world appearance statistics. Distribution improvement uses the separate frozen 32768-sample tests.

pickupAccounting: Policy15 logs observed completion transitions rather than relying on intended targets. Count unique entry-uncollected/terminal-collected nodes with actual E-segment evidence. Supplement missed extraction telemetry only through the same-run settled inventory proof; exact completion times remain observation bounds. Unreconciled terminal pickups are diagnostic failures, never silently empty returns. At most three actual remains per trip.
